relevance.rationale: Identified from front matter (hep-th preprint). No ref() entry, no \cite{} site, no Lean -- Ref:, arXiv id absent from content/ -> orphan on all three checks. Subject is the SL(2,C) Chern-Simons wave function on hyperbolic knot complements, worked out for the figure-eight and the three-twist knot -- the corpus's own knots and the same state integral. Checked specifically against the brief's Stokes question and it does NOT bear on it in the way a title-level read would suggest: the words Stokes, Borel, resurgence and Donaldson-Thomas do not occur in the body at all (only in its bibliography), and its footnote 1 states explicitly that its resummation is of a *convergent* series and does not involve divergent-series resummation. Its integrality conjecture is about the holomorphic blocks of the resummed WKB q-series and the cancellation of the ll in 2 pi Q singularities, which is a different object from the resurgent Stokes constants of GGM Conjecture 3(d). So it neither proves nor refutes the statement the corpus over-claims. What it does supply is (i) a clean, quotable separation of the convergent-q-series layer from the Borel/resurgent layer, which rem:channel-rotation-askey-lit item 3 currently runs together, and (ii) a calibration datum on the BPS identification (see keyResults). Supporting, not core: no result here is consumed by any block, and the integrality conjecture itself is conjectural and unverified in this setting.

keyResults.locator: Sec 6 Conclusions, first open question (its ref [42] = `dimofte-gaiotto-gukov2013`)
keyResults.statement: The interpretation of the integrality structure of the resummed WKB wave function 'in terms of an enumerative problem, or a BPS counting problem, in the dual supersymmetric theory' is listed as an open question raised by the work, citing the same 3d-3d dictionary the corpus's bridge invokes.
keyResults.useForFolio: Calibration for conj:stokes-dt-bps-bridge, which adopts Stokes = DT = dim H_BPS(T[K]) and describes the first equality as 'proved ... for the figure-eight 4_1'. This document shares an author with `garoufalidis-gu-marino2023peacock` and, on the same knots, treats the BPS-counting reading of its integer invariants as open. IMPORTANT CAVEAT to carry with any use: those integers are the holomorphic-block integrality invariants of a convergent q-series, NOT the resurgent Stokes constants, so this is adjacent evidence about authorial stance and not a statement about Conjecture 3(d) itself. Scope-(a).

keyResults.statement: The q-series obtained by resumming the WKB expansion is a resummation of a convergent series and therefore does not involve the techniques of resummation of divergent series such as Borel resummation.
keyResults.useForFolio: rem:channel-rotation-askey-lit item 3 says the Andersen-Kashaev state integral 'factors into a q-series and a q~-series' whose leading asymptotics trace Vol + i CS, and the corpus's Stokes/Habiro discussion sits next to it. This is a one-line source for the fact that the q-series factorisation layer and the Borel/resurgent layer are analytically different regimes -- useful because conflating them is a live failure mode in the c_k and A_omega chains.

keyResults.statement: The resummed WKB q-series wave function has apparent singularities at every ll in 2 pi Q (i.e. at roots of unity q = exp(i ll)), absent from the non-perturbative definition; a conjectured integrality of the holomorphic blocks makes them cancel against the anti-holomorphic blocks, leaving a finite wave function, with the epsilon-expansion mechanics in Appendix A.
keyResults.useForFolio: A stated cancellation mechanism at rational points, worked explicitly for the figure-eight in Sec 4.1 and Sec 5. Recorded against conj:stokes-dt-bps-bridge only as context for the same 4_1 wave function; there is no block that consumes it, which is why the verdict stays supporting.

proposedActions.rationale: Orphan; same knots and same state integral as the corpus's A_omega / c_3 chain, and needed as the source for the calibration remark below.

One remark covering both usable items: that a GGM co-author lists the BPS-counting interpretation as open (calibrating the bridge block's 'proved ... for the figure-eight' wording), and that the integrality in question is the convergent-q-series holomorphic-block kind, not the resurgent Stokes kind -- so it is adjacent evidence, not a refutation. State explicitly what remains unchecked: whether the holomorphic-block integers and the resurgent Stokes constants of the same knot are related at all.
